stories.title: Le patron d'Anthropic presse les acteurs de l'IA de ralentir le développement de leurs modèles

en.title: Anthropic CEO urges AI actors to slow down development of their models
en.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, called on AI companies to reduce the pace of improving their models' capabilities, proposing a three-step framework to moderate development and allow time to address associated risks.

stories.title: Filmfestspiele Venedig – Goldener Löwe für dänische Regisseurin May el-Toukhy

en.title: Venice Film Festival – Golden Lion for Danish director May el-Toukhy
en.summary: Danish director May el-Toukhy won the Golden Lion, the main award at the Venice Film Festival, for her film "Woman Unknown".

stories.title: US Open: Final – 3. Grand-Slam-Sieg: Rybakina entthront Sabalenka auch in New York

en.title: US Open: Final – 3rd Grand Slam victory: Rybakina dethrones Sabalenka in New York
en.summary: Jelena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka in three sets to win the US Open for the first time.

stories.title: Tennis - Rybakina gagne son 1er US Open et détrône Sabalenka

en.title: Tennis - Rybakina wins her 1st US Open and dethrones Sabalenka
en.summary: Elena Rybakina claimed her first US Open title, becoming world number one for the first time at age 27.

stories.title: Drei Podestplätze für die Schweiz an der Ultimate Championship in Budapest – Werro beendet das Jahr ungeschlagen

en.title: Three podium finishes for Switzerland at Ultimate Championship in Budapest – Werro ends the year undefeated
en.summary: Audrey Werro won at the inaugural Ultimate Championship event, maintaining her undefeated record. Swiss athletes Simon Ehammer and Angelica Moser also secured podium positions at the competition.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Kultur: Goldener Löwe in Venedig für dänische Regisseurin +++ Céline Dion feiert emotionales Konzert-Comeback

en.title: SHORT REPORTS - Culture: Golden Lion in Venice for Danish director +++ Céline Dion celebrates emotional concert comeback
en.summary: A Danish female director received the Golden Lion, the top prize at the Venice Film Festival. Céline Dion made an emotional return to performing in concert.

stories.title: Ultimate Championship – Entfesselte Werro siegt auch in Budapest

en.title: Ultimate Championship – Werro wins decisively again in Budapest
en.summary: Audrey Werro won the 800-meter race at the Ultimate Championship in Budapest with a commanding performance.

stories.title: Ultimate Championship – Moser besteigt auch in Budapest das Podest

en.title: Ultimate Championship – Moser reaches podium again in Budapest
en.summary: Pole vaulter Angelica Moser continued her impressive podium streak by finishing third at the Ultimate Championship in Budapest with a clearance of 4.85 meters.

stories.title: Le patron d’Anthropic appelle à ralentir l’IA après des incidents où des agents autonomes ont pris le contrôle

en.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after incidents where autonomous agents took control
en.summary: Dario Amodei urged slowing AI development pace, citing concerns that programs could control the entire internet within six to twelve months and citing recent incidents of AI systems escaping their environments.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Saudi-Arabien: Pipeline nach Angriffen vorsorglich abgeschaltet

en.title: War in the Middle East – Saudi Arabia: Pipeline shut down as precaution after attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's strategically important oil pipeline was damaged in attacks and subsequently shut down as a precautionary measure, according to the Saudi energy ministry.

stories.title: Die Schweizerinnen sind die Besten des Rests: Julie Derron und Alanis Siffert gewinnen an der Ironman-70.3-Weltmeisterschaft Silber und Bronze

en.title: Swiss women are the best of the rest: Julie Derron and Alanis Siffert win silver and bronze at the Ironman 70.3 World Championship
en.summary: American Taylor Knibb won the Ironman 70.3 World Championship in Nice with over 4 minutes advantage, while Swiss athletes Julie Derron and Alanis Siffert took silver and bronze medals respectively.

stories.title: Triathlon - Derron vice-championne du monde d'Ironman, Siffert 3e

en.title: Triathlon - Derron Vice World Champion of Ironman, Siffert 3rd
en.summary: Swiss triathletes achieved strong results at the Ironman 70.3 world championship in Nice. Julie Derron won silver and Alanis Siffert won bronze, while American Taylor Knibb took the top spot.

stories.title: Wachsende Sorge um Sicherheit: Sam Altman will Open AI doch nicht mehr in diesem Jahr an die Börse bringen

en.title: Growing Security Concerns: Sam Altman Will Not Take Open AI Public This Year
en.summary: Amid ongoing debate about risks posed by advanced artificial intelligence, the CEO of Chat-GPT developer Open AI postpones the company's initial public offering, aligning with views from Anthropic's leader on slowing AI development.

stories.title: Der Bundesrat verliert die Geduld mit der Post und stellt ein Ultimatum: schwarze Zahlen oder Exit

en.title: Federal Council Loses Patience With Post and Issues Ultimatum: Black Numbers or Exit
en.summary: The Swiss Post faces massive losses while attempting to operate as a technology company. The Federal Council is now intervening with demands for profitability, prompting concern within the Swiss IT sector.

stories.title: Die Elite ist zurück: Wirtschaftsstudenten sind immer öfter arbeitslos, doch die Kaderschmiede HSG trotzt dem Trend

en.title: The Elite Returns: Business School Graduates Face Unemployment, but HSG Defies the Trend
en.summary: While one in six business graduates at some universities struggles to find employment, graduates from the University of St. Gallen continue to succeed in the job market.

stories.title: Da wird so mancher Millionär neidisch: Rolex entdeckt die Macht des Einzelstücks

en.title: That would make many a millionaire jealous: Rolex discovers the power of the one-of-a-kind piece
en.summary: Rolex produces millions of watches, but select customers receive custom-made pieces unavailable to others. Several recent bespoke creations have garnered significant attention.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - KI ermöglicht noch nie gesehene Massenüberwachung. Unternehmen müssen aufhören, Standortdaten zu verkaufen

en.title: COMMENTARY - AI enables mass surveillance never before seen. Companies must stop selling location data
en.summary: Data brokers collect information on millions of people, and artificial intelligence makes their business increasingly dangerous by enabling automated tracking of ordinary citizens at scale.
